payload.artist_html: J. D. Daza, E. G. Selling, K. M. Jenkins, E. L. Stanley, D. S. Doucet, G. Fotanarrosa & A. M. Bauer
payload.credit_html: "Evidence of male anatomy in a mid-Cretaceous Burmese miniaturised amber gecko"
payload.description_html: Carinasquama rusmithii referred specimen, HMNS.PB.729, showing details of the integument. A. Dorsal view of the specimen, showing the head and back scales; B. Ventral view, at the level of the cloaca; C. Dorsal view of the manus; D. Ventral view of the manus; E. Details of the multi-carinated scales on the dorsum of the tail; F. Ventral view of the pes; G. Lateral view of the head, showing the nostril, orbit, and teeth.
